# stalwart_spam_llm (Resource)

Configures the LLM-based spam classifier. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state. Requires an Enterprise license.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

### Optional

- `categories` (Set of String) The expected categories in the LLM response
- `confidence` (Set of String) The expected confidence levels in the LLM response
- `model_id` (String) The AI model to use for the LLM classifier
- `prompt` (String) The prompt to use for the LLM classifier
- `response_pos_category` (Number) The position of the category field in the LLM response.
- `response_pos_confidence` (Number) The position of the confidence field in the LLM response.
- `response_pos_explanation` (Number) The position of the explanation field in the LLM response.
- `separator` (String) The separator character used to parse the LLM response.
- `temperature` (Number) The temperature to use for the LLM classifier

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
